# @trysac/mcp-schema-lint

> Lints MCP tools/list results against ten rules: tool name format and portability, duplicate names, descriptions, input schema root and required entries, parameter types and descriptions, and token budgets. Text and JSON reports. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations, zero runtime dependencies. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage, API, rules and CLI
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules, processing steps and boundaries
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test files and how coverage works
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and input limits

## Optional

- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope and effort metrics
